jobs.title: Web Development Intern
jobs.description:
Overview

We are looking for a Web Dev Intern who want to learn fast and build real websites and functional dashboards, not just tutorials. You help team ship sites, fix bugs, and get taste of live client work at fast-moving agency. Good place if you want turn code skill into shipped product.

The best work starts with the best team. Help us build it.

Duration (1 to 3 months).

Requirements

Strong command on HTML, CSS, JS. Bonus if know React or similar framework.
Understand responsive design, git basics.
Strong knowledge about no code platforms such as Webflow, Wordpress, Shopify , etc.
Curious mind - dig into problem.
Comfortable in fast-paced, deadline-driven setup.
Currently studying or recent graduate in CS/IT related field (or self-taught, portfolio required).

Responsibilities

Build and maintain client websites alongside senior devs.
Turn design (Figma) into working code, pixel-close.
Debug, test, fix issues across projects.
Learn agency workflow - QA, deployment.

What You Will Get

Real client work - your code will be shipped.
Mentorship from senior devs, hands-on not hand-off.
Exposure to full agency dev stack and process.
Fun and dynamic environment to learn and build something great.

If this feels like your kind of place, we'd love to meet you.

‍

Apply Now

jobs.title: Backend Web Developer Intern
jobs.description:
IIMaspirant.in | Remote | 1–2 Months | Unpaid

About IIMaspirant.in IIMaspirant.in
is an emerging EdTech platform focused on helping students prepare for competitive management entrance examinations, including CAT and IPMAT
.
We are currently developing our next-generation Learning Management System (LMS)
to create a structured digital learning environment for aspirants.
The platform is being built across multiple layers — including learning experiences, student dashboards, assessments, mock tests, payments, user management and other technology-driven learning systems.
We are now looking for a Backend Web Developer Intern
to contribute to the backend architecture and help connect our frontend applications with reliable, scalable backend services.

💻 About the Role As a Backend Web Developer Intern
, you will work closely with our product and frontend development teams to build and integrate the backend systems powering our LMS.
This is a hands-on, project-based internship
where you will work on actual product requirements, APIs, databases, integrations and backend workflows.
One of the key projects during the internship will be the PayU payment gateway integration
, along with backend systems required to support the LMS and other platform functionalities.
You will have the opportunity to work across the complete flow:
Frontend → API → Backend → Database → Third-Party Services → Response → Frontend

🎯 Key ResponsibilitiesBackend Development Develop, maintain and improve backend APIs for the IIMaspirant.in LMS.
Build RESTful APIs for frontend applications.
Connect frontend components with backend services.
Design and implement database structures required by the platform.
Develop server-side business logic and validation.
Implement authentication and authorization where required.
Handle API errors, validation and backend exceptions.
Write clean, modular and maintainable backend code.

💳 Payment Gateway Integration A major component of this internship will involve working on the PayU payment infrastructure
, including:
Payment initiation workflows.
Server-side payment processing.
Transaction and order management.
Payment success and failure handling.
Callback and webhook implementation.
Payment-status verification.
Server-side hash generation/validation.
Database synchronization of payment transactions.
Handling duplicate or repeated payment events.
Automated access activation following successful payments.
Payment-related debugging and testing.

🎓 LMS & Platform Development You may also contribute to backend modules supporting:
User registration and authentication.
Student profiles.
Course and learning-content management.
Enrolment and access management.
Mock tests and assessments.
Test results and performance data.
Dashboard APIs.
Subscription/payment-related workflows.
Notifications and communication systems.
Admin and internal management APIs.
Other backend services required by the LMS.

🤝 Collaboration You will work alongside our frontend development and product teams
to ensure smooth communication between the user interface and backend infrastructure.
Your responsibilities will include:
Understanding frontend requirements.
Translating product requirements into backend functionality.
Designing appropriate API contracts.
Integrating APIs with frontend applications.
Testing complete frontend-to-backend workflows.
Debugging integration issues.
Documenting APIs and backend functionality.
Participating in technical discussions and development reviews.

🛠️ Required Technical Skills Candidates should have a good understanding of:
Backend web development
REST APIs
HTTP/HTTPS
API authentication
Webhooks
Databases
Git & GitHub
JSON
Server-side programming

Experience with at least one
of the following is expected:
Node.js / Express.js

PHP / Laravel

Python / Django / Flask

Java / Spring Boot

Or another comparable backend technology

Database Knowledge Basic working knowledge of one or more:
MySQL
PostgreSQL
MongoDB
Firebase
Other relational or NoSQL databases

⭐ Good to Have Candidates with experience in any of the following will be preferred:
Payment gateway integrations
PayU / Razorpay / Stripe APIs
Webhook implementation
LMS or EdTech platforms
API testing
Database design
Cloud/server deployment
Linux
Authentication systems
Git workflows
Frontend-backend integration

Prior PayU experience is not mandatory.

What matters most is your ability to understand API documentation, solve problems independently and build reliable backend systems.

👨‍💻 Who Are We Looking For? We are looking for someone who:
Enjoys backend development.
Can take ownership of assigned technical tasks.
Is comfortable learning independently.
Can understand existing codebases.
Has strong problem-solving ability.
Pays attention to security and data integrity.
Is comfortable working in a collaborative product environment.
Can commit consistently throughout the internship.
Wants practical experience building a real technology product.

Students, recent graduates and self-taught developers with strong project experience are welcome to apply.

📌 Internship Details Position:
Backend Web Developer Intern
Company:
IIMaspirant.in
Internship Type:
Project-Based
Duration:
1–2 Months
Work Mode:
Remote
Compensation:
Unpaid
Experience Level:
Student / Fresher / Early-Career Developer
Industry:
EdTech / Technology
There is no application fee or payment required
to apply for this internship.

🚀 What You Will Work On This internship is designed around real product development
, not theoretical assignments.
Depending on the project roadmap, your work may include:
LMS Backend → API Development → Database → Frontend Integration → PayU → Payment Verification → User Access → Testing & Deployment

You will gain practical exposure to how modern web applications are connected and how backend systems support a live digital product.

📈 Why Join IIMaspirant.in? This is an opportunity to work on a product that is actively being built and improved.
You will get exposure to:
Real APIs

Real databases

Real payment workflows

Real frontend-backend integration

Real product requirements

Real debugging & problem solving

The objective is to give you meaningful experience contributing to an actual EdTech technology stack and a project that can demonstrate your engineering capabilities.

📩 How to Apply Interested candidates should apply through LinkedIn with:
1. Resume / CV

2. GitHub profile

3. Portfolio or relevant projects

4. Brief introduction

5. Backend technology/framework you are most comfortable with

Candidates with relevant GitHub repositories or deployed backend projects are strongly encouraged to include them.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the next stage of the selection process.

Build. Integrate. Ship. Learn. If you are passionate about backend engineering and want to contribute to the technology behind a growing EdTech platform, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now and build with IIMaspirant.in.
